It's a reality faced by many creators in countries subject to economic sanctions or currency fluctuations. Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

The COREMERCH Edge Commerce Stack is designed to work when platforms fail, by providing a decentralized infrastructure that allows you to collect payments directly from your customers, without relying on a single point of failure. By using GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, and NOWPayments for automatic on-chain crypto payment verification, you can build a digital store that is resilient to censorship and economic fluctuations. With the Edge Commerce Stack, you can deploy your store in 48 hours, with full control over your infrastructure and data ownership, and scale your business without relying on a centralized platform.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before you can deploy the Edge Commerce Stack, you need to have a GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages account, a Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script account, a Supabase or Google Sheets account, and a NOWPayments account. You also need to have a domain name and a payment method set up. Once you have all the necessary accounts and settings, you can start deploying the Edge Commerce Stack, which will guide you through the process of setting up your payment and delivery pipeline, and deploying your store in 48 hours.
